items.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: This is crazy. Victor Bailey! (yells out) Good God, yeah. OK, here we go. Me, Victor Bailey, Donald Harrison, Smitty Smith, the principle guys who went. There were a couple of other guys who went. Maybe Cecilia Smith, this vibes player. We hopped a train and we went to New York. Kenny lived two blocks from Port Authority. So we walked in, rang his doorbell. He said, “Who is it?” I said, “It’s Branford.” “Oh yeah, what’s up man?” He rang the doorbell. We had this jam session. We played a bunch of tunes. He said,…
